issues.message: 13 fence/pane/wall block(s) have no north/east/south/west set although a neighbour would connect, so they show as lone posts: (0, 0, 1), (1, 0, 1), (2, 0, 1) and 10 more.
Only 4 block types: mix materials (STYLE.md palette).

visual.summary: Five sharpened spruce stakes with a slab walk on oak fence posts behind. Reads as a palisade; plain and all one wood.
problems: The oak fence posts under the walk stand as lone unjoined posts, and the sharpened fence points would grow arms into the taller stakes beside them: brace the posts to the stakes and keep the points as lone points
Almost all spruce log (58 %): a cobblestone footing under the stakes would tie it to the stone base of the other buildings
Levels 2 and 3 only add torches and a bit of moss: give each level something you can see (stores under the walk, hanging lanterns, a banner)

visual.summary: Sharpened spruce stakes on a cobblestone footing, a slab walk on braced posts behind. The plain first level.
problems: The outside face is one flat plane of logs: an odd stake set half a block forward (a log on a slab) or a second, lower row would give it depth
